check_in_zh: 今天练了吗？在 App 里点打卡，连续打卡满 7 天解锁新场景。

dialogue.en: Thanks for your time today. I'll keep this short — I want to show you where the Storm 2 migration stands and what it means for the business.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: 开场先说 I'll keep this short，stakeholder 最爱听这句
dialogue.zh: 谢谢大家的时间。我长话短说——给大家看看 Storm 2 迁移的进展，以及它对业务意味着什么。

dialogue.en: Sounds good. Give us the headline first.
dialogue.speaker: James

dialogue.en: Headline: we're 80% done, on track for end of month. Once live, the Drova pipeline will handle 3x traffic without the latency spikes we saw on Storm 1.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: headline 先行：进度 + 时间 + 业务价值，三句话
dialogue.zh: 结论：完成了 80%，月底能按时上线。上线后 Drova pipeline 能扛住 3 倍流量，不会再出现 Storm 1 时代的延迟 spike。

dialogue.en: That's a big improvement. What's driving the 3x number?
dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.zh: 提升很大。3 倍这个数字怎么来的？

dialogue.en: Great question. The new topology partitions by event time, so hot partitions don't bottleneck the whole pipeline anymore. We validated it with last week's traffic replay.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: Great question 先接住问题，再回答——这是汇报时的黄金起手
dialogue.zh: 问得好。新的 topology 按 event time 分区，hot partition 不会再拖慢整个 pipeline。我们用上周的流量重放验证过了。

dialogue.en: Nice. Any risks we should know about?
dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.zh: 不错。有什么风险是我们需要知道的吗？

dialogue.en: One, honestly — the Zookeeper config is complex, and we're still validating failover. Tom's reviewing it with me this week, so we should be clear by Friday.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: 说风险时用 honestly 显得坦诚；同时给出 mitigation 和时间点
dialogue.zh: 有一个，说实话——Zookeeper 配置比较复杂，failover 还在验证。Tom 这周跟我一起 review，周五前应该能确认。

dialogue.en: Appreciate the transparency. And the team — how are they holding up?
dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.zh: 感谢这么坦诚。团队呢——大家状态怎么样？

dialogue.en: They've been amazing, honestly. The network engineers jumped in on every issue — I couldn't have gotten here without them.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: 公开感谢团队，stakeholder 面前给团队 credit 是加分项
dialogue.zh: 说实话他们特别棒。network engineers 每个问题都冲上来帮忙——没有他们我走不到这一步。

dialogue.en: Good to hear. Keep us posted.
dialogue.speaker: James

dialogue.en: Will do. I'll send a one-pager after this call. Thanks everyone!
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: Will do + 承诺发 one-pager，汇报的标准收尾
dialogue.zh: 一定。会后我发个 one-pager 给大家。谢谢！

key_phrases.en: Headline: we're 80% done, on track for end of month.
key_phrases.note: 先给结论：进度 + 时间，三句话讲清
key_phrases.zh: 结论：完成 80%，月底按时上线。

key_phrases.note: 回答问题前的黄金起手，给自己争取思考时间

key_phrases.en: One, honestly — the config is complex, and we're still validating failover.
key_phrases.note: 坦诚说风险，同时给出 mitigation
key_phrases.zh: 有一个，说实话——配置复杂，failover 还在验证。

key_phrases.en: The team jumped in on every issue — I couldn't have gotten here without them.
key_phrases.note: 公开给团队 credit，加分项
key_phrases.zh: 团队每个问题都帮忙——没有他们我走不到这一步。

key_phrases.en: I'll send a one-pager after this call.
key_phrases.zh: 会后我发个 one-pager 给大家。

practice_zh: 跟读 5 分钟：打开 TTS 逐句跟读，重点练 Headline: we're 80% done 的干脆语气
替换练习 5 分钟：把 80% / 3x / Zookeeper 换成你项目的真实数字，大声说 3 遍
汇报模拟 5 分钟：从 Thanks for your time today 开始，一个人演完 12 句，回答问题时先说 Great question
roleplay_zh: 假设你要给 stakeholder 汇报你的项目进展。用英文讲 3 分钟：开场承诺简短、headline 三句话、回答一个风险问题、公开感谢团队、承诺发 one-pager 收尾。
scene_zh: 给 stakeholder（James、Priya）汇报 Storm 2 迁移进展。目标是讲清业务价值、坦诚说风险、公开感谢团队，最后承诺发 one-pager。
title: Presenting to Stakeholders
